title: Unique unit-valued lift of compatible approximate characters
statement: Let C be a commutative ring, G a group, and J an ideal such that C is complete and separated for its J-adic filtration. Suppose a_n : G → C satisfy a_m(g)−a_n(g) ∈ J^n for n ≤ m, a_n(1)−1 ∈ J^n, and a_n(gh)−a_n(g)a_n(h) ∈ J^n for all n,g,h. There is a unique homomorphism b : G → Cˣ such that b(g)−a_n(g) ∈ J^n for all n,g.
lean_statement: ∀ {C G : Type} [CommRing C] [Group G] (J : Ideal C) [IsAdicComplete J C] (a : ℕ → G → C), (∀ (n m : ℕ), n ≤ m → ∀ g : G, a m g - a n g ∈ J ^ n) → (∀ n : ℕ, a n 1 - 1 ∈ J ^ n) → (∀ (n : ℕ) (g h : G), a n (g * h) - a n g * a n h ∈ J ^ n) → ∃! b : G →* Cˣ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : G), (b g : C) - a n g ∈ J ^ n
